consumer: A frontend/engine LOS check asking 'does the avatar have live line of sight to this nearby tile right now?'
scope: The avatar's current line-of-sight predicate to a specific tile within sight range (live visibility, not draw-remembered seen state)
decisive_source: map::pl_sees — an engine LOS-with-range predicate, but in a headless backend its underlying visibility/seen cache is never populated by a draw pass, so it does not reflect live LOS
divergence: A tile one step away in a fully unobstructed straight line: the avatar plainly has LOS, but the headless export reports seen=false (no draw populated the cache), so the surface answers 'no LOS' when LOS exists
